Package org.apache.hadoop.record

Class Buffer

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.record.Buffer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable, Comparable
@Deprecated @Public @Stable public class Buffer extends Object implements Comparable, Cloneable
Deprecated.
Replaced by Avro.
A byte sequence that is used as a Java native type for buffer. It is resizable and distinguishes between the count of the sequence and the current capacity.
